description: A frame in its sequence: the shots just before and after it in the same episode / film, in order, each with its still and caption — to see how a moment is built, or to lay a beat out across several canvas panels. With clips: true, each shot's clip plus the continuous "run" video that covers them (run_url, with from/to seconds).

clips.description: true = also return each frame's clip and sequence videos (1 credit per video on top of the call). Ask only when the user wants to see it move.

frame_id.description: A frame id from earlier results (or "slug:label")

name: get_animation_sequence
